description: Calculate a sidereal (Lahiri) Vedic birth chart: the ascendant, the nine grahas with sign, degree, nakshatra and house, and the navamsa, dashamsa and hora ascendants. Requires birth date and coordinates. Birth time improves accuracy and defaults to 12:00 when unknown.

language.description: Set to "hi" to add Hindi (Devanagari) names next to the English ones, for answering in Hindi.

place_name.description: Optional place name as the user gave it, used only to prefill the details link.

time.description: Local birth time at the birth place, HH:MM. Defaults to 12:00 if unknown.

name: get_birth_chart
title: Vedic birth chart
